responsibility: Provides the generated documentation URL mapping for Moxie target options declared in moxie.opt. This metadata file associates each user-visible -m switch such as meb, mel, mmul.x, and mno-crt0 with the corresponding anchor in the GCC manual’s Moxie options section, so GCC’s option-help and diagnostics infrastructure can attach stable manual links to target-specific options without duplicating the option definitions themselves.
